details:
Space Mission Odyssey is a 3D astronaut game built in Unity. You play an astronaut on a 20-mission campaign that runs from the Moon through low Earth orbit and Mars to the outer worlds and deep space.

How it plays:

Pick a mission: choose one from the campaign, or use Mission Roulette to roll a random operation by type and difficulty.
Suit up: the armory has 6 suits with different oxygen, radiation resistance, mobility and jet fuel. A character editor lets you customize your astronaut.
Complete objectives on the surface: a timer runs while you follow waypoints to deploy relay masts, repair an antenna, collect samples, scan survey points or rescue crewmates. Oxygen, health and radiation are shown on the HUD, and you have five abilities on keys 1-5.
Finish and level up: return to the lander, earn up to 3 stars, credits and XP, then answer a mission-control quiz question. There are also medals to earn, daily operations and a flight pass.

The game also has a Mission Architect mode, where you design a CubeSat and fly its operations.
